column2: Oh, I know this one! We have 4, add 1. Pull the 5 down... then take away the 1. Um, that gives 8?
The small friend, 4! Take away 4, not 1. Now it shows 5. Thank you!
We have 9, add 6. The big friend of 6 is 4, so take away 4... done! It shows 5?
The 10! Add 10 on the next rod first. Now it shows 15. Thank you!
We have 11, take away 2. Take 10 from next door... all done! It shows 1?
The big friend, 8! Add back 8. Now it shows 9. Thank you so much.
We have 6, add 7. Add 10 next door. Now take away 3... but there are no little beads to take! I am stuck.
Take 5 and add 2! That is taking away 3. Now it shows 13. Two friends, one move. Thank you!
